title: Enneanuclear [Ni6Ln3] Cages: [LnIII] Triangles Capping [NiII6] Trigonal Prisms Including a [Ni6Dy3] Single-Molecule Magnet

material_class.structural_family: Ni6Ln3 cage: Ln3 triangle capping a Ni6 trigonal prism / corner-sharing Ni2Ln2 cubanes

synthesis.procedure: All manipulations under aerobic conditions. Complexes 1–3 were prepared from Ni(ClO4)2·6H2O (110 mg, 0.3 mmol), the corresponding Ln(NO3)3·6H2O (0.3 mmol; Ln = Gd for 1), and H3L (78 mg, 0.3 mmol) with excess NEt3 in MeCN under solvothermal conditions (95 °C, 20 h). After cooling to room temperature, the green solution was layered with Et2O (10 mL), giving green crystals after ~4 days. Yield ~35–45%. Presence of base is required; NEt3, NMe4OH, or NaOH all afford the same products by IR/PXRD. Bench-top (non-solvothermal) conditions did not give crystalline material.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solvothermal reaction under aerobic conditions, then diethyl ether layering
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: After cooling, the green MeCN solution was layered with 10 mL Et2O; green crystals of 1·5.75MeCN·2Et2O·1.5H2O were isolated after ~4 days.

properties.summary: dc χMT (0.1 T, 5–300 K) shows dominant ferromagnetic interactions for the Gd analogue. Room-temperature χMT = 32.14 cm3 K mol−1 (calc. 30.55 for 6 NiII + 3 GdIII). χMT rises to 44.80 cm3 K mol−1 at 9 K then falls to 7.66 cm3 K mol−1 at 5 K. Curie–Weiss θ = 8.18 K (50–300 K). Fit of χMT with a 3-J model (PHI): J1(Gd–Gd) = −0.42 cm−1, J2(Gd–Ni) = 0.80 cm−1, J3(Ni–Ni) = 13.13 cm−1, gNi = 2.13, gGd = 2.

source_locations.location: Experimental Section, General Synthetic Procedure for Complexes 1–3

material_class.structural_family: Ni6Ln3 cage: Ln3 triangle capping a Ni6 trigonal prism / corner-sharing Ni2Ln2 cubanes

synthesis.procedure: Same general procedure as 1–3: Ni(ClO4)2·6H2O (110 mg, 0.3 mmol), Dy(NO3)3·6H2O (0.3 mmol), and H3L (78 mg, 0.3 mmol) with excess NEt3 in MeCN, solvothermal 95 °C for 20 h. After cooling, the green solution was layered with Et2O (10 mL). For the Dy analogue the isolated solvate is 2·2MeCN·2.7Et2O·2.4H2O. Yield ~35–45%.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solvothermal reaction under aerobic conditions, then diethyl ether layering
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Green MeCN solution layered with 10 mL Et2O; green crystals of 2·2MeCN·2.7Et2O·2.4H2O isolated after ~4 days.

properties.summary: dc χMT (0.1 T) suggests potentially dominant antiferromagnetic interactions (with Stark-level caveat). Room-temperature χMT = 48.50 cm3 K mol−1 (calc. 49.42); nearly constant to ~50 K then falls to 25.89 cm3 K mol−1 at 5 K. Curie–Weiss θ = 0.74 K (50–300 K). Zero-field ac susceptibility shows frequency-dependent fully formed χM″ peaks below ~3.6 K, establishing SMM behavior. Arrhenius fit: Ueff = 23.84 K, τ0 = 3.63×10−8 s (quoted as 24 K in abstract/conclusions). MAGELLAN electrostatic model: Dy ground-state anisotropy axes nearly coplanar, pointing toward corners of the Ni6 trigonal prism and tilted toward capping nitrates.

measurements.name: Ueff
measurements.conditions: zero dc field ac susceptibility; Arrhenius fit of χM″ peaks below ~3.6 K

synthesis.procedure: Same general procedure as 1–3: Ni(ClO4)2·6H2O (110 mg, 0.3 mmol), Er(NO3)3·6H2O (0.3 mmol), and H3L (78 mg, 0.3 mmol) with excess NEt3 in MeCN, solvothermal 95 °C for 20 h. After cooling, the green solution was layered with Et2O (10 mL) to give green crystals of 3·5.75MeCN·2Et2O·1.5H2O. Yield ~35–45%. EDS on bulk crystals of 3 gave Ni:Er = 64.9:35.1 (theory 66.6:33.3).
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solvothermal reaction under aerobic conditions, then diethyl ether layering
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Green MeCN solution layered with 10 mL Et2O; green crystals of 3·5.75MeCN·2Et2O·1.5H2O isolated after ~4 days.

properties.summary: dc χMT (0.1 T) for the Er analogue is near the spin-only value at 300 K (40.28 vs 41.35 cm3 K mol−1), decreases slightly to 38.03 cm3 K mol−1 near 15 K, then rises to 38.96 cm3 K mol−1 at 5 K. Curie–Weiss θ = −1.03 K (50–300 K), consistent with dominant antiferromagnetic interactions (Stark-level caveat). No SMM ac parameters are reported for 3.
